_comment: Copy this to domingo.json next to domingo.py and fill it in. Never commit the result: it holds your token. Leave url, key and advertise empty to let Domingo find a local Strata on its own.
name: my windows pc
token: a secret you make up, at least 16 characters

_fields.name: label shown in the sidebar
_fields.host: what to bind. 127.0.0.1 is the default and the safe one
_fields.token: required by every device that connects. Domingo refuses to bind a shared address, or to advertise one, without it
_fields.url: the model server, for example http://127.0.0.1:18500. Leave empty to let Domingo find a local Strata by itself
_fields.key: the model server's API key. It stays on this machine and is never sent to a browser. Leave empty to use the key recorded by the server
_fields.model: model id to select by default. Leave empty to take the server's first model
_fields.advertise: the address your other devices use, for example https://your-machine.ts.net:8443, when a proxy such as Tailscale Serve forwards to this port. Leave empty if nothing forwards here
